title: yourShika's Backpacks
description: A standalone, server-side backpack system for Paper/Spigot
body:
# yourShika Backpack's

> A standalone, **fully server-side** backpack system for **Paper/Spigot**.
> Players do **not need a client mod**.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.4.0-6E5BC8)](https://github.com/yourShika/yourShika-Backpacks/releases)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Plattform-Paper%2026.1.2-5BE8D4)](https://papermc.io)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-25-orange)](https://adoptium.net)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lizenz-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

---

## 📦 Description

**yourShika Backpacks** brings high-quality, **customizable** backpacks with their own
inventories to your survival server—protected against duplication bugs, persistently
saved, and ready for your own custom textures.

The plugin is **inspired by [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)
([GitHub](https://github.com/P3pp3rF1y/SophisticatedBackpacks))**, but is a
**completely independent new development**. **No code, no assets, and no
textures** were taken from that mod. **This is not a Forge/Fabric/NeoForge mod, but
a Paper/Spigot plugin.**

---

## 🧱 Minecraft/Paper Version

- **Target platform:** Paper (also runs on Spigot, though MiniMessage appearance may be limited there)
- **Built against:** `io.papermc.paper:paper-api:26.1.2.build.72-stable`
- **Java:** **25** required (Minecraft 26.1.x requires Java 25, Microsoft OpenJDK 25)
- **Versioning scheme:** Since the introduction of the new `YY.D.H` scheme, the Paper API uses
  `<version>.build.<n>-<stage>` instead of `-R0.1-SNAPSHOT`. The target version can be
  easily changed via the `paper.version` property in the [`pom.xml`](pom.xml).

---

## ✨ Features

- ✅ Backpacks as **regular items** with a **unique, tamper-proof ID** (PDC)
- ✅ **Separate inventory per backpack** – same items, different contents
- ✅ **Persistent storage** (SQLite or YAML)
- ✅ **Secure GUI** with comprehensive duplicate/loss protection
- ✅ **Double-chest layout (54 slots)** – only unlocked slots are usable
- ✅ **Higher tiers = more space**; automatic **paging** when a page is exceeded
- ✅ **6 backpack tiers** (Leather, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite)
- ✅ **Truly customizable** using dyeable leather items (DyeColor **or Hex `#RRGGBB`**) –
  Color visible **even without a resource pack**
- ✅ **Crafting recipes** (configurable, can be enabled/disabled)
- ✅ **Open via right-click** (main & off-hand) **and command**
- ✅ **Admin give command** and **open by ID**
- ✅ **CustomModelData + `item_model` component per tier** – ready for resource packs
- ✅ **Modular hook system** – all external hooks **disabled by default & experimental**,
  Live status via **`/bp modules`**
- ✅ **German, configurable messages** (MiniMessage + `&` codes)
- ✅ **Protection against backpacks-in-backpacks**
- ❌ **No Vault** anymore (intentionally removed)

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Download the plugin JAR from [Releases](https://github.com/yourShika/yourShika-Backpacks/releases)
   (`yourShika-Backpacks-0.1.0.jar`).
2. Place it in the `plugins/` folder of your **Paper 26.1.2 (Java 25)** server.
3. Start the server—the **`plugins/yourShika Backpack's/`** data folder will be automatically
   created with `config.yml`, `messages_de.yml`, and the database.
4. Optionally customize `config.yml` and run `/bp reload`.

---

## ⌨️ Commands

Main command: `/backpack` · Aliases: `/bp`, `/ybackpack`, `/ysbackpack`

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/bp help` | Show help |
| `/bp open` | Open the backpack in your hand |
| `/bp info` | View backpacks, upgrades, and **recipes** in a GUI |
| `/bp list [player]` | List backpacks |
| `/bp color <color> [accent]` | Dye the backpack (DyeColor name **or** `#RRGGBB`) — **Admin** |
| `/bp give <player> <tier> [quantity] [color] [accent]` | Give a backpack (Admin) |
| `/bp openid <ID>` | Open a backpack by ID (Admin) |
| `/bp modules` | Enable/disable external modules **via GUI** (Admin) |
| `/bp update` | Load the latest version from GitHub (Admin, restart required) |
| `/bp reload` | Reload configuration (Admin) |
| `/bp version` | Plugin info |

> **Dyeing for players** is done via the **Crafting Table** (see below); the
> command `/bp color` is intentionally a **admin** function.

## 🎒 Backpacks, Tiers, Size & Paging

Each backpack opens as a **double chest (54 slots)**. The bottom row (9 slots)
is the **control bar** (Scroll, Info, Upgrade Preview). Of the remaining
**45 slots**, only as many are **unlocked** as the tier allows—the rest are
locked. Tiers with more than 45 storage slots are automatically split across multiple
**pages** (◀ / ▶).

| Tier | Storage Slots | Pages* | Upgrade Slots | CustomModelData |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leather | 9 | 1 | 1 | 1001 |
| Copper | 18 | 1 | 2 | 1002 |
| Iron | 27 | 1 | 3 | 1003 |
| Gold | 45 | 1 | 4 | 1004 |
| Diamond | 54 | 2 | 5 | 1005 |
| **Emerald** | 81 | 2 | 6 | 1006 |
| Netherite | 108 | 3 | 6 | 1007 |

\* With 45 usable slots per page (`gui.storage-slots-per-page`).
The upgrade slots can be accessed via the **Upgrades button** in the backpack GUI as
a separate inventory.

### Identity & Security

Each backpack stores its **ID, tier, and colors in the PersistentDataContainer**—not in
its name or lore. This means backpacks **cannot be spoofed by renaming**.
**The contents are never stored in the item** itself but are bound to the ID on the server side.
This is the core of the anti-duplication protection: A copied item shares the same inventory.
When scrolling, only the visible page is synchronized between the inventory and the buffer
—the operation remains atomic and dupe-proof.

### Colors (truly dyeable)

Backpacks are based by default on a **dyeable leather item**
(`LEATHER_HORSE_ARMOR`). The **main color actually dyes the item**—visible
**even without a resource pack**—and can be changed using `/bp color`. Both
**DyeColor names** (`BROWN`, `CYAN`, …) and **hex values** (`#A0703C`)
are allowed as colors. Leather horse armor cannot be equipped by the player and is therefore
ideal as a backpack base.

---

## 🎨 CustomModelData, item_model & Resource Packs

- Each animal has its own **CustomModelData** (1001–1007) and can optionally
  set a modern **`item_model` component** (`item-model: “namespace:path”`).
- **Without a resource pack**, backpacks function as normal (colored) leather items.
- **With a resource pack**, they appear as unique items.
- **External item systems** (Nexo, ItemsAdder, Oraxen) are **optional** and
  experimental—see Hooks. The default is always the built-in vanilla provider.

### Oraxen Assets

In the `src/main/resources/oraxen/` directory, you’ll find a complete Oraxen add-on with
64x64 vanilla-style PNGs for all backpack tiers, tier upgrade items, and
52 pre-made function upgrades (Pickup, Magnet, Filter, Void, Transfer,
Crafting/Processing, Stack, Utility, Tank/Energy/XP). The textures have been intentionally
upscaled from 16x16 pixel art to match Minecraft items. The backpack textures
use three layers: a dyeable base (`*_base.png`), fixed accent variants
(`accents/<tier>_<dye>.png`), and an overlay for outlines, tier metal, and
shiny details. The plugin config references the base IDs via `provider-id`;
for different accent colors, the plugin automatically uses provider IDs such as
`ysbp_leather_backpack_accent_red`. Real backpacks are still created
via plugin crafting, smithing, or `/bp give`, so that the ID, contents, owner, and
color are preserved.

The feature upgrades are set up as model/texture providers
(`ysbp_upgrade_<upgrade_key>`, CustomModelData `2100-2151`); their gameplay logic
can be integrated with them later.

---

## 🧰 Crafting, Upgrade Chain & Dyeing

**Only the leather backpack** is crafted directly (8× leather at a **chest**).
All higher tiers are created via the **upgrade chain** at the Smithing Table.
Newly crafted backpacks display their **ID immediately** in the lore.

**Upgrade Chain** — Leather → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Emerald → Netherite:

1. Craft **Leather Upgrade**: 1× Leather (center) + 4× Thread (Crafting Table).
2. Craft a **Tier Upgrade**: Upgrade Leather + 8× Tier Material (e.g., Copper) →
   *Copper Upgrade* (Crafting Table). **Netherite Upgrade**: **Smithing Table** –
   Upgrade Leather (Template) + Netherite Ingot (Base) + Thread (addition).
3. **Refining at the Smithing Table:** **Regular Leather** (template) + **previous
   backpack** (base) + **Tier Upgrade** (addition) → next backpack.
   **ID, contents, and color are retained.** (Upgrade leather is not accepted in the template slot
  —real leather belongs there.)

**Dyeing (Crafting Table):** Place the backpack in the **middle column**, dyes in
the **left column** = main color, **right column** = accent color. Within
a column, the position doesn’t matter; multiple dyes are mixed into a single **hex value**
. The backpack’s contents remain completely intact.

> The actual recipes appear in the **Recipe Book** and in **JEI/REI/EMI**. The
> position-independent dyeing is not a fixed recipe and is therefore not listed there.

---

## 💾 Storage

- **SQLite** (default, recommended) → `backpacks.db`
- **YAML** (alternative) → `backpacks.yml`

Data is saved when **closing**, when **changing pages**, upon **logout**,
**plugin deactivation**, **server shutdown**, and via **autosave**.

**Update-safe (MUST):** Content is stored in the **versioned Paper-Byte format**
(`serializeAsBytes`)—including the Minecraft data version. Upon loading,
DataFixer automatically migrates to the current version, ensuring that items with any
custom NBT/components **are not lost or corrupted** after updates. Older data in the old format is still read and automatically migrated the next
time you save.

---

## 🔌 External Modules / Hooks (Automatic)

The plugin runs **completely independently**. External hooks are encapsulated as **modules**
and activate **automatically** as soon as the respective plugin
is installed and the module is enabled in the config (**default: enabled**).
If the plugin is missing, the module remains inactive.

Live status & switching **via GUI**: **`/bp modules`** (Clicking on a module
toggles it and reloads it).

| Module | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **PlaceholderAPI** | `%ysbp_count%`, `%ysbp_highest_tier%`, `%ysbp_open%` | auto |
| **PacketEvents** | Packet display of placed backpacks (Roadmap) | auto |
| **Oraxen** | Custom models/textures | auto |

> **Custom Items:** **Oraxen** is the only supported custom item hook
> (free to use, mature API). **Nexo** (paid) and **ItemsAdder** (Premium)
> have been intentionally removed. A `provider-id` can be set per tier, which only
> takes effect if the Oraxen module is active. **Vault is intentionally not supported.**

Disable a single module (example):

```yaml
hooks:
  modules:
    oraxen: false
```
